title: An easy front door. A deeper AI workspace.
subtitle: One engine, two ways to use it
bullets: Find a space: search, result, review, confirm.
AI workspace: plan a batch, compare first fit, explore the models.
Both use the same engine and simulation calendar in the same storage context.
note: Local: SQLite on one computer. Public: one browser profile on the same origin, not a shared university calendar.

title: Six methods. A specific job for each.
subtitle: Observable reasoning, with a clear scope

methods.name: Constraint satisfaction
methods.body: Check time, capacity, equipment, access and room–computer conflicts.

methods.name: Hill climbing
methods.body: Five seeded starts; accept improving single or pair moves.

methods.name: A* graph search
methods.body: Find a low-cost route in an example floor graph. Step-free paths avoid stairs.

methods.name: Bayesian inference
methods.body: One noisy report updates P(free). With no report, keep the prior.

methods.name: Hidden Markov model
methods.body: Filter a sequence of noisy reports, then predict the next occupancy slot.

methods.name: Sequential decisions
methods.body: Book, inspect, wait or leave using finite-horizon backward recursion.

note: No report: retain the prior. No sequence: HMM is inactive. The decision advisor does not rank rooms. This is not value iteration.

title: An observation can change the best next action.
subtitle: A small, specified probability model
bullets: An assumed free report changes 0.60 into 0.894737.
At belief 0.60 and horizon two, inspection has the highest expected assumed utility.
HMM sequences and waiting use specified 0.80 / 0.35 occupancy transitions.
note: Checked against engine.posterior and engine.decision. No model was trained. Synthetic beliefs and utilities, not measured occupancy or accuracy.
